editorial:
Imagine you are a young director named Jasper who finally gets his big break, but the set is a creepy old children's shelter. You and your crew head inside to film a séance, thinking it will be an easy way to get some cool footage. However, things go south fast when the doors lock and the ghosts of old orphans start messing with everyone. It feels like a wild ride where you never know if you should be screaming in fear or laughing at how ridiculous the situation is. The vibe is a perfect mix of spooky and silly, making it great for a group hangout.

You will love how the movie keeps the energy high with quick jokes and sudden scares that actually work. The acting feels real, and the chemistry between the crew members makes you care if they make it out alive. While a few plot points feel a bit rushed, the twists keep you guessing until the end. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the ghostly details. You could also rent it on Apple TV if that is easier, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out that Jasper was not just filming the ghosts, but actually helping the sinister force bring them back to life. He makes a deal with the spirits to become famous. In the end, the spirits trick him and pull him into the walls of the shelter forever. The rest of the crew barely escapes as the building collapses, leaving Jasper as the newest ghost in the home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies that do not take themselves too seriously.
